title: Early-state and late-output marginals do not identify within-unit prediction
result: Group-level temporal co-movement or matched marginal means cannot establish that early molecular response predicts later output at the follicle/patient unit level.
HF01_implication: Early state mean improvement + later output mean improvement != within-unit predictive relation.
Destructive early assays require explicit unit-linkage or hierarchical replicate design before predictive/recoverability claims.
A time arrow alone does not repair missing unit identity.
claim_boundary: This is a mathematical non-identifiability example. It does not assert that any cited biological study made this error; it defines the evidence needed for stronger HF01 claims.
